label: 背侧侧坐 / 扭身后撑
pose_lead: Grounded pose, back-turned side-sit with rear support and twist:
lower_limbs: Both legs fold toward the same side, one leg passing in front while the other tucks near the hip.
upper_limbs: At least one hand props on the ground behind the body, the other arm staying close behind the torso.
torso_head: The chest lifts as the upper body rotates backward, the shoulder line and the pelvis pointing different ways; the head follows the turn.
weight_silhouette: The lumbar twist is the essence; a clear spiral line runs from the hips through the shoulders.
